title: Answers of the bot: context, k, reranker and model, scope A

corpus.label: scope A
corpus.description: the wiki of a management software (Italian, screenshots)
corpus.source: a markdown export of the wiki, imported as it is
corpus.images_detail: 15,044 screenshots and 1,808 icons described by a vision model; 23 SVG not described

sample.how: 60 precise and 40 broad questions drawn from the approved ones (fixed seed), and 20 questions with no answer in the documents: 10 plausible for that software but not covered, 10 off-topic

judge_rules: score from -10 to +10 with a reason; the judge reads the question, the expected answer, the bot's answer and the sources given to the bot (up to 18,000 characters)
"I don't know" scores 0; information taken from the sources is not invented; leaving something out is not an error
good: score of 7 or more; wrong: below 0; the score of a variant is the mean of the judges

gpu_host.use: every model: embeddings, reranker, answers, judges, image descriptions, OCR models
gpu_host.rule: everything stays in the 16 GB of VRAM, nothing offloaded to the CPU

cpu_host.use: gosidian, the plugins, Qdrant and PostgreSQL, the converters that run on the CPU

software.gosidian: development builds released as v2.91.1, v2.93.0 and v2.94.0 (column gosidian)

base.search: Qdrant, paragraphs only, Qwen3-Embedding-8B at 2048 numbers, ef 128
base.context: the paragraphs found, up to 24,000 characters
base.model: gemma4:12b (Ollama, Q4_K_M) with a context of 12,288 tokens

metrics.score: mean of the two judges, -10 to +10
metrics.good / wrong / invented: share of answers scored 7 or more / below 0 / with something not in the sources
metrics.precise / broad / out of scope: mean score on each part of the sample
metrics.dont_know_out: share of out-of-scope questions answered with the fixed "I don't know" sentence (recognized automatically from v5 on)
metrics.expected_doc: share of precise and broad questions whose expected document is among the sources given to the model
metrics.citation_precision: share of the citations that point to the expected document

variants.label: no reranker
variants.change: the first 5 paragraphs of the index

variants.label: title
variants.change: the reranker reads the path of headings too

variants.label: qwen3 14B
variants.change: answer model qwen3:14b instead of gemma4:12b

variants.label: section
variants.change: each paragraph found brings its whole section

variants.label: section, v5
variants.change: section; the question rewritten with the history; a fixed "I don't know"

variants.label: section + images
variants.change: section; the images of the sources placed in the answer

variants.label: section + images, v2
variants.change: the same, with the prompt that puts each image under its step

variants.label: neighbours + images
variants.change: the paragraph with its neighbours instead of the section

variants.label: document + images
variants.change: the whole document of each paragraph found

notes: the judges agree: per variant gemma4 and qwen3 are 0.05-0.7 points apart, nearly always less than 0.3; the qwen3 judge too scores the answers of qwen3:14b below those of gemma4
a reranker threshold for "I don't know" never raises the score: a cut below 0.5 removes only good answers
gemma4 says by itself that the documentation does not cover it on all 20 out-of-scope questions; qwen3:14b sometimes invents
latency: one question at a time, 10 questions; qwen3:14b (10.8 GB) does not fit next to the query embedding model, Ollama swaps them and each answer takes about 3 times as long
Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API gives gemma4 a context of 4,096 tokens and cuts longer prompts without a word: the answer and judge models run with num_ctx 12,288
with images in place (section + images): 84% of the answers carry images, 208 in all; the paragraph above an image cites that image's source in 89% of cases; 120 answers in 657 s

choice.what: context: the section of each paragraph found; k 5; 20 candidates without the title; no threshold; gemma4:12b with 12,288 tokens of context; images placed in the answer
choice.why: the whole section is the largest gain (broad questions from 4.94 to 7.43); 8 paragraphs of sections water down the precise answers; the reranker is worth +0.7; qwen3:14b scores lower and is slower on this card
